title: Both ES256 and PS256
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1; HCERT Specification, 3.2.2 Signature Algorithm; RFC 8230 RSA algorithms with COSE (PS256). QR Code Generation, 6. Step 5 — Sign as a COSE_Sign1: “Both algorithms MUST be implemented, even though only one is used to sign any given certificate”.

statements.label: Both ES256 and PS256
statements.requirement: The library SHALL implement signing and verification for ES256 (alg -7, ECDSA P-256 with SHA-256) and PS256 (alg -37, RSASSA-PSS with SHA-256, MGF1 SHA-256, salt length 32, modulus at least 2048 bits).
